appearance: Dry night race, with blue-hour race start.
terrain_character: Flat coastal city, pale paved and sandy verges, sparse formal palms and sea-side open space.
distinctive_geometry: Pit building: exposed white horizontal frame, recessed dark glazing, stacked balcony decks and cantilevered roof.

Diamond Tower construction site: exposed concrete core/floorplates, temporary upper formwork and crane at retained footprint1244131504. Planned432m/93levels are not observed completed dimensions; construction mass uses an approximate300±80m visual envelope.
Jeddah EDITION: low horizontal coastal hospitality mass with balconies and planted terraces.

sectors.name: Pit straight, T1–3
sectors.observed: Long white layered pit building on right, opposite roof stand; close sponsor walls and tall catchfence. Large green/blue painted escape at first left/right. Palms and low white utility buildings beyond wall.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Southern fast esses
sectors.observed: Narrow asphalt channel between concrete and continuous mesh; red-white narrow apex kerbs, occasional green-painted outer lane. Blue evening sky over white apartment and event blocks, not continuous generic forest.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Fast coastal sequence toward northern hairpin
sectors.observed: Fast coastal sequence behind close fencing and residential balconies. The Diamond Tower site is visible ahead/right as an exposed concrete construction core with crane in323s; no finished glazed skyscraper facade should be inferred from the planned OSM height.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Northern T13 banked hairpin
sectors.observed: Broad round hairpin with green painted outside apron and red-white inside kerb. Pale coastal buildings and hospitality above fence; low palms on planted islands. Preserve curved protection and clear paved escape geometry.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Return technical sweepers
sectors.observed: Fast close-wall bends, palm clumps and flat white/cream buildings behind mesh. Paint stays alongside kerb instead of blanket gravel; visible repeated lamp poles with paired arms.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T17–21 direction changes
sectors.observed: Interlinked narrow wall corridors; large blue-green paved escape only where justified, red-white kerbs at individual apexes. Low service compounds and palms; night lighting must show asphalt and wall base.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Long southern acceleration and T22–26
sectors.observed: Long flowing fenced run, articulated pit/hospitality visible across road loop. Sponsor bridges and uninterrupted light rows; small green verge beside wall; no grass parkland replacing paved shoulders.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T27 hairpin and return pit straight
sectors.observed: Wide slow left turnaround, coloured paved runoff and terminal impact barriers, mainstand and high white-framed pit decks dominate. Preserve hotel/site access behind fence, continuous curved outer protection.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

dimensions_policy: OSM XY footprints are registered geographic evidence. Tagged height and levels are retained verbatim; missing/zero heights are unknown. Roof/detail sizes and sparse-vegetation spacing in native authoring are visual estimates pending cockpit comparison.

source_registration.method: Nearest native centerline sample after retained local tangent projection and uniform scale.
source_registration.landmark_extent_note: Centroid station can fall on adjacent arm of circuit; use actual ring and terrain, not centroid station alone. Overlapping compound roof footprints must never become solid road obstructions.

elevation_review.status: Coarse surface model; unresolved racing-deck details explicitly retained.
findings: GLO-90 is not racing-deck height on the close coastal roads. Preserve flat visual horizon rather than propagating roofs into road.
Barrier-vertex median widths cannot reproduce chicane escape lanes; author terminal protection behind paved escape, never directly across turn exit.

primary_sources.title: Circuit operator
primary_sources.supports: 6.174 km, 27 turns, waterfront course, more than 2000 lights.

required: Cockpit contact sheet covering all sectors, including each landmark approach and both road edges.
No floating tiles, barriers crossing drivable lane, closed escape mouths, or faceted long curves.
Compare curb colour/extent, runoff surface/depth, fencing, tree placement and skyline per sector against timestamps.
Review night illumination for asphalt visibility and dark sky, or daylight landscape contrast as appropriate.
acceptance.status: Reference inventory and scene recipe authored; native runtime acceptance is separate.

authored_edges.side_convention: Numeric+1 is driver right, -1 is driver left. Shader runoff widths clamp to exported collision shoulders.
authored_edges.registration: Intervals visually estimated against mapped native curves and supplied video; not a surveyed curb or safety-installation trace.
authored_edges.physical_escape_review: Large terminal escape mouths still need explicit footprint geometry and matching collision-barrier changes. Surface ribbons must not extend through existing collision walls.

native_scene_status: Authored geometry and type checks complete. Native cockpit review and collision acceptance are pending.
scenery_grounding: Mapped buildings use the lowest footprint terrain level. Stand fronts have retaining bases and rear supports extend to sampled terrain. Trees avoid all road arms and mapped building footprints.
source_conflicts: Retained city footprints can cross the modeled road corridor. Native facade authoring clips ground walls outside the road mask plus 1.2 m and records the removed area; these are disclosed registration conflicts, not validated building surveys.

braking_markers.side_convention: Numeric+1 is driver right, -1 is driver left. Board sequences are on the outside of the main braking approach.
braking_markers.placement_policy: Heavy braking approaches selected from mapped official corner sequence and indexed reference sectors. Stations and exact event mounting locations remain estimates. Standard150/100/50boards are shortened to100/50on selected compact street-corner approaches.

barrier_branding.coordinate_frame: Native source station metres; numerical +1 is driver right and -1 is driver left.
barrier_branding.artwork: Original typeset event panels with observed identity and palette; no video pixels or extracted game textures are shipped.
barrier_branding.registration: Wall identities are visible in the listed sparse reference frames. Native intervals are estimated from corner and landmark registration, with approximately 75 m endpoint uncertainty; edited playback is not treated as a linear station clock.
barrier_branding.unbranded_sections: Retain bare Armco and concrete outside these explicit bands. Unsupported legible identities are left without a substitute sponsor. A sponsor bridge alone is not evidence for a matching roadside band.

apron_paint_review.reviewed: Overview and detailed frames across the lap; specific added motifs are tied to the listed frame timestamps. Paint registration is estimated from official corners and landmarks, not proportional playback time.
apron_paint_review.geometry: Original vector shapes, road-branch height with sample=scene.at(station), clipped away from the road. No reference pixels shipped.
apron_paint_review.native_changes: No corridor extent or physical surface-class changes.
apron_paint_review.unpainted_policy: Reference shows mostly bare asphalt escape lanes and narrow green wall-side strips, already present. No decorative hatching is invented.

observed.name: Jeddah floodlight recipe
observed.structure: Slim curved-neck paired-head road poles, staggered about 32 m apart; three larger set-back stadium banks beside the early esses.
observed.confidence: High for mixed pole families; moderate for primary road-pole distribution; low for estimated 16/29 m heights and exact tower stations.

night_lighting.render_power: Dimensionless estimates for diffuse-field calibration, not measured watts or lumens. Every optical center retains its own base-ground elevation.
night_lighting.pit_lane_clearance: Roof-mounted pit-side banks/supports remain above the authored roof, with field ground_z tied to native road/garage ground. Other fixed masts are set beyond garage rear depth, not placed in the pit lane when native shoulder is narrowed to0.10m.

pit_lane.registration: Authored Corniche garage frontage scene.pit_building(5830,210,+1) lies 13 m beyond road edge. Reference235/239/243/303s places the multi-level garage balconies on driver right and main stand left. Interval crosses native zero; width is the actual authored garage-front offset, not a surveyed pit-lane measurement.
pit_lane.source_world_frame: Native east/north station frame; +1 driver right, -1 driver left. No route-origin rotation.

targeted_registration_review.method: Direct appearance/topology checks of retained frames and bounded individual Baku reference seeks; source geometry and all native data unchanged.
